thread:
jonathan: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need concrete tests added to catch the regression that caused KV-cache mismatch under high QPS. Assigning owners and timelines here so it doesn't slip.

maya: Agreed. I sketched an initial list: unit test for KV serialization, an integration regression harness with 10k reqs/min, and a targeted prompt set to verify prefix cache reuse.

sara: Can you paste the prompt examples? I can integrate into the eval runner.

jonathan: Sure — two seed prompts: 
1) short chat turn with repeated prefix tokens 
2) multi-turn conversation that reuses earlier context heavily.

kevin: I ran a local loop reproducer yesterday. FWIW the failure spikes at ~7k rps on the 80-token average seq. Adding a load test in CI that ramps to 8k for 10m should flag it.

maya: Proposal for action items (short):
- owner: kevin -> add load test in perf-suite, ramp to 8k, schedule weekly smoke (due: 2026-04-02)
- owner: sara -> add prompt set to regression-evals repo and a small acceptance test (due: 2026-03-30)
- owner: jonathan -> instrument KV-cache metrics + alert on miss rate delta > 5% (due: 2026-03-29)
- owner: maya -> write a chaos drill playbook (node/worker restarts + kv latency injection) and run with eng-sre next run (due: 2026-04-06)

ops-bot: Reminder: please add items to the postmortem tracker with labels `regression-test` and `chaos-drill`.

kevin: I'll open PR for the load harness today. Question: should the load test be gated (block PRs) or only run on main nightly?

jonathan: Nightly for now + optional manual gating on release branches. If it generates too many flakes we can move to lab-only.

maya: For the prompt-set, prefer a small curated set (~12 prompts) that exercise cache boundary conditions, not a huge corpus — want CI-fast checks. Sara can expand to larger offline evals.

sara: Yep. I'll commit `experiments/kv-regression/prompts.yaml` and wire to eval-runner. Will add a flag `--strict-kv` that fails on content divergence.

kevin: Quick snippet for the load job I'll add to perf-suite CI: 
```
# perf-job config
ramp_to: 8000
sustain_for: 600 # seconds
seq_length_avg: 80
clients: 100
```

jonathan: Good. Also add a small canary: run the job with quantized model + fallback variant to ensure fallbacks keep behaving.

maya: Chaos drill notes (draft):
```
- scope: dedicated-serving-pool
- attacks: redis-latency + process-kill for 30s on random worker
- windows: 5m attack / 10m recovery x 3
- success criteria: <1% user-facing errors, automatic fallback to model-variant, alerts closed within 15m
- runbook owner: maya
```

ops-bot: Scheduled a recurring row in incidents calendar: "kv-cache regression drill" 2026-04-08 10:00 UTC.

jonathan: Recurring patterns we observed: regressions correlate with small config changes to kv-serializer and high bursty traffic during exports. We should add a changelog-gated eval: any PR touching `serving/kv*` must auto-trigger the small regression CI.

maya: I'll add a GH workflow trigger for path filters. Owner: maya (due 2026-03-31).

sara: I'll also add a regression test that runs within 5 minutes locally (`make kv-reg-test`) so devs can iterate quickly.

kevin: I'll attach the reproducer logs to the ticket and link PRs: https://redwood-inf.example/p/INC-7423 - includes traces and perf summaries.

jonathan: Perfect. Quick checklist here so SOC can sign off: owners + due dates, CI job ids, chaos drill scheduled. If anyone can't meet due date call it out now. :thumbsup:

maya: Dates look ok from my side.

kevin: On track. PR later today.

sara: On track. Will ping when prompts are in.

jonathan: Closing here — will update postmortem tracker with the action items and mark as `testing-added`. We'll reconvene after the first drill run to validate. Thanks everyone.
